items.title: Clarify candidate ledgers and scheduler boundary in the ProofStory plan
items.context: Fix four/five rule mismatch; make candidate milestone ledger gate-consumed only after accepted intent interpretation; state slicing is required for oversized ledgers but automatic parallel execution is optional and belongs to Scheduler/Unattended/Autopilot work.
items.userSees: The decision document clearly distinguishes candidate versus confirmed milestone ledgers and says oversized ledgers require slicing before DEV, while automatic parallel child-story execution remains a later scheduler/autopilot capability.

happy.desc: The document says the progressive model has five rules and lists five rules.
The lifecycle text treats milestone ledgers before intent collision as candidate ledgers and only gate-consumes them after accepted intent interpretation.

edge.desc: The document does not imply child stories must run in parallel when many milestones exist.

adversarial.desc: The document keeps Scheduler/Unattended/Autopilot automatic parallel execution out of the MVP implementation scope.
